scope: Official apartment and operator websites for downtown or near-downtown Chicago. These are building prospects, not guaranteed available units.
limitations: Rents and availability are the official site's observed claims on the research date and can change; search retrieval may contain cached content.
Amenity yes means the building advertises it, not that a parking space or functioning charger is available to a new resident.
Unknown does not mean no. Charger count, connector type, charging price, reservation rules and waitlists were not verified unless explicitly stated.
Quoted total monthly prices and prices with unspecified fee treatment are not relabeled as base rent. Base rent remains null for those properties.
Coordinates were not verified and are null. Do not fabricate precise map pins.
Nice and cozy are subjective. The atmosphere notes are editorial impressions based on advertised design and amenities, not resident ratings.
73 East Lake is a near-budget watchlist prospect, with the observed base price above the requested ceiling. Marlowe has no verified rent in the retrieved official content.
